nodes.label: main.go
nodes.description: Entrypoint to the application. It initializes the game loop and handles input from the user.

nodes.label: game_loop.go
nodes.description: Contains the game loop that updates the game state and renders the UI. It listens for user input and updates the game state accordingly.

nodes.label: board.go
nodes.description: Manages the game board and the state of the pieces. It contains the logic for moving pieces and checking for checkmate.

nodes.label: ui.go
nodes.description: Manages the UI components and their layout. It displays the game board and handles user interactions.
